build_hunyuan3d_paint_pipeline: build a three-stage pipeline that UV unwraps a mesh, generates multi-view textures, and bakes them onto a 3D mesh
run_hunyuan3d_paint_preprocess_stage: run the preprocess stage to UV unwrap a mesh, apply image delight, and render multi-view normal and position maps
run_hunyuan3d_paint_texgen_stage: run the texture generation stage to denoise multi-view latent tensors into painted texture images using a transformer model
run_hunyuan3d_paint_postprocess_stage: run the postprocess stage to bake multi-view textures onto a mesh and export the final textured OBJ or GLB file
create_ddim_solver: create a DDIM solver that computes accelerated sampling steps from alpha cumulative products for fast diffusion denoising
